g.text: Each testing layer answers a different question.
Component integration · service + policy + fake adapter
End-to-end · user interface through the running system
Do invalid approvals and expiry boundaries produce the right decision?
Does the service enforce the decision and handle the adapter result?
Do actual filesystem rules, collisions, and permissions behave correctly?
Can the user complete the intended journey safely and understand the result?
This runnable lab covers the first two layers—not real files or browser journeys.
